title: The Helpful note in the margin
subtitle: 互助关爱 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 互助关爱（社会服务与人际沟通·互助与关爱）
meta: 主题语境：互助关爱（社会服务与人际沟通·互助与关爱）　|　核心词汇：helpful　|　正文 337 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 helpful 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1980 the keeper wrote of ① a helpful note in the margin in the calendar, and everybody in the tower said at once that it was ② more helpful than the one named there the year before. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the keeper, who never explained anything, had done it without a word of thanks and gone home; it was the helpful ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most helpful note in the margin anybody in the tower had ever seen, or so the calendar for January 1974 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too helpful to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the traveller who had come to help; the helpful ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the clock at the far stair, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a helpful neighbour upstairs, and said that no traveller in his right mind would call it ⑥ as helpful as the neighbour upstairs they had once had in the old tower. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was helpful or not, and he said so.

By 1987 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the calendar. What the line asked for was ⑦ something helpful, and nothing besides. The traveller from the next tower called the whole plan ⑧ quite helpful; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the calendar kept the names of the helpful ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1990, at once, she wrote of another helpful note in the margin in the same calendar, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ more helpful than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most helpful neighbour upstairs in the whole tower, she said in 1992, was the one she could never quite name; the helpful ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 有帮助（前置定语 a helpful note in the margin：1980 年守夜人在年历里记下的那件有帮助的批注）
B. adj. 有帮助／乐于助人（比较级 more helpful than：文中两处，一处比页边有益的批注，一处比预想）
C. adj. 有帮助／乐于助人（最高级 the most helpful：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 有帮助（表语 too helpful to do：母亲觉得它太有帮助，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 乐于助人（前置定语 a helpful neighbour upstairs：叔叔把整件事称作一桩乐于助人的邻居）
F. adj. 乐于助人（同级比较 as helpful as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩楼上乐于助人的邻居相比）
G. adj. 乐于助人（后置定语 something helpful：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 乐于助人（受程度副词修饰 quite helpful：那位过路人的评价）

items.q: a helpful note in the margin
the most helpful note in the margin anybody
The most helpful neighbour upstairs in

answers.why: helpful 意为“有帮助”，1980 年守夜人在年历里记下的是“一件有帮助的批注”，此处作前置定语 a helpful note in the margin。
helpful 意为“有帮助”，此处用比较级 more helpful than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
helpful 意为“有帮助”，年历上 一月 那行字说它是钟楼里最有帮助的一件，故用最高级 the most helpful note in the margin。
helpful 意为“有帮助”，母亲认为这件东西“太有帮助了，谁也用不上”，too helpful to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
helpful 意为“乐于助人”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩乐于助人的邻居”，此处作前置定语 a helpful neighbour upstairs。
helpful 意为“乐于助人”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩楼上乐于助人的邻居一样乐于助人”，同级比较用 as helpful as。
helpful 意为“乐于助人”，年历上那半行字要的是“乐于助人的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something helpful。
helpful 意为“乐于助人”，邻钟楼来的那位过路人认为这套计划“相当乐于助人”，quite 修饰原级 helpful。
helpful 意为“乐于助人”，1990 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要乐于助人”，故用比较级 more helpful than。
helpful 意为“乐于助人”，母亲 1992 年说的是“整个钟楼里最乐于助人的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most helpful neighbour upstairs。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1980 年，守夜人在年历里记下了一件有帮助的批注。（a helpful note in the margin）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更有帮助。（more helpful than …）
母亲觉得它太有帮助，谁也用不上。（too helpful to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩乐于助人的邻居。（a helpful neighbour upstairs）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩楼上乐于助人的邻居一样乐于助人。（as helpful as …）
到了 1987 年，年历上只剩半行字：要的是一件乐于助人的东西。（something helpful）
answers: In 1980 the keeper wrote of a helpful note in the margin in the calendar.
Everybody said it was more helpful than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too helpful to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a helpful neighbour upstairs.
He said nobody would call it as helpful as the neighbour upstairs they had once had.
By 1987 the calendar asked for nothing but something helpful.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 helpful 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1980 the keeper wrote of a helpful note in the margin in the calendar, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most helpful note in the margin in the tower, or so the calendar says.
My mother thought it too helpful to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a helpful neighbour upstairs, and nobody argued with him.
The traveller from the next tower called the plan quite helpful, and everybody laughed.
The helpful ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
